marker.text: Kody is the home your agents share. You keep using the AI agent you already have (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, Grok, OpenClaw, or any other MCP-capable host) and connect it to your Kody account. That agent gains durable state that outlives the conversation and keeps working while your computer is off. Connect a second agent tomorrow and it finds the same home already furnished.
